questions: Which existing methods are closest to training-time context-enriched triple/path supervision for multi-hop KGQA, and does the proposed idea already exist under different terminology (e.g., knowledge-grounded instruction tuning, graph-augmented LM pretraining, contextualized triple encoding, passage-grounded KG supervision)?
Is same-passage context actually available or derivable for MetaQA/WebQuestionsSP/ComplexWebQuestions, and how do prior KGQA/KGC works align triples to source text (passage-to-triple grounding)?
Which datasets, baselines, metrics and evaluation protocol apply, and what reported numbers must be beaten (per-hop Hits@1, hop-depth breakdown, leakage controls)?
Is low-hop-only RL optimization known to transfer to deeper-hop queries in multi-hop KGQA, or does hop-depth/compositional generalization require curriculum or mixed-hop training?

Can the adaptive repair loop be distinguished from existing iterative self-training / self-refine / bootstrapping data-cleaning methods, and is there precedent for automated one-hop failure detection?
Is the full pipeline feasible with available code and compute (fits a 1-7B LM with LoRA/RL), and which components are off-the-shelf versus must be built and validated?
search_topics: training-time subgraph/knowledge supervision for language models
knowledge-grounded instruction tuning and graph-augmented LM pretraining
contextualized triple encoding for knowledge graph completion (KG-BERT, KICGPT, SimKGC, StAR)
passage-to-triple alignment and KG construction from text / open information extraction grounding
multi-hop KGQA benchmarks MetaQA WebQuestionsSP ComplexWebQuestions
hop-depth and compositional generalization in multi-hop reasoning
reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning (PPO/GRPO, process rewards, verifiable rewards)
curriculum learning and shallow-to-deep transfer in multi-hop QA
iterative self-training, self-refine, bootstrapping, error-driven data augmentation
inference-time subgraph retrieval and GraphRAG for KGQA (contrast class)
knowledge graph incompleteness and missing-link repair
noisy supervision and label noise in KG-grounded training
comparison_targets: Triple/path-only fine-tuning of the same base model (internal primary baseline)
EmbedKGQA (doi:10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.412) - multi-hop KGQA over sparse KGs with KB embeddings
GreaseLM / MHGRN (doi:10.18653/v1/2020.emnlp-main.99) - PTLM + multi-hop graph relation network over subgraphs
KICGPT (doi:10.18653/v1/2023.findings-emnlp.580) - LLM with KG context for knowledge graph completion
SG-RAG MOT (doi:10.20944/preprints202505.1992.v1) and other GraphRAG/inference-time subgraph prompting methods (contrast: context at inference vs training)
STRuCT-LLM (arxiv:2506.21575) - RL for tabular/graph semantic parsing
Curriculum/iteration baselines: one-pass denoising vs iterative self-training (Self-Refine arxiv:2303.17651; KnowTrace arxiv:2505.20245)
